title: Workflow Builder Enhancements — Editor UX + Node Types
description: Improve the visual workflow builder with better editing UX, smarter node configuration, proper conditional branching, and additional n8n-inspired node types. Currently the builder has 6 basic node types with single-input/single-output topology. This epic adds: edit button from detail page, topic autocomplete for job nodes, dual-output condition nodes (true/false branches), and new node types (HTTP Request, Code/Transform, Switch, Loop, Sub-workflow, Error Trigger).
architectureNotes:
**Existing foundation:** ReactFlow builder with 6 node types (job, approval, delay, condition, notify, fan-out). BaseNode component provides single input (top) + single output (bottom) handles. NodeConfigPanel has per-type Zod schemas. WorkflowCanvas has definitionToGraph/graphToDefinition converters.

**Key architectural changes needed:**
1. BaseNode must support multiple named output handles (for condition true/false, switch branches)
2. Edge metadata needs branch labels (which handle the edge connects from)
3. graphToDefinition must serialize branch info into step config
4. Topic autocomplete needs a backend endpoint or use existing config/topics data

**Node type additions (n8n-inspired, adapted for AI agent orchestration):**
- HTTP Request: call external APIs as workflow steps
- Code/Transform: JS expression to transform data between steps
- Switch: multi-branch condition (N outputs)
- Loop: iterate over array, run sub-steps per item
- Sub-workflow: invoke another workflow as a step
- Error Trigger: catch errors from previous steps, run recovery logic
epicRails: All new node types must follow BaseNode pattern with memoized components
Topic autocomplete must support free text entry (not just selection)
Condition/Switch dual outputs use named ReactFlow handles with IDs
graphToDefinition must preserve branch routing metadata
New node types need both builder config (NodeConfigPanel) and run visualization (RunOverlayNode)
No dangerouslySetInnerHTML in any node rendering
